interface.longDescription:
LoomaScale connects Google Ads to ChatGPT and Codex for marketers, agencies and business owners. Audit campaigns, find wasted spend, research keywords and review conversion tracking. Manage campaigns when you request changes. Audits do not change campaigns or settings.

What can I do with Google Ads?
- Audit campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords and search terms for wasted spend and negative keyword opportunities.
- Review conversion tracking, disapproved ads and budget pacing; compare performance across periods, devices and locations.
- Research keyword ideas, search volume, competition and bid estimates.
- Create and manage Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns, ads, keywords, bids and budgets after your approval. New campaigns start paused.

What can I do with Meta Ads, Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads?
- Audit campaigns, ad sets and ads across Facebook and Instagram.
- Analyze spend, reach, frequency, conversions, cost per acquisition (CPA) and return on ad spend (ROAS); review creative performance and possible fatigue signals.
- Compare placements and audience breakdowns where available, investigate delivery issues and review budget pacing.
- Create and manage campaigns and ads when you request changes.

What can I do with Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel)?
Review connected datasets/pixels, event activity over the last 1-7 days and Event Match Quality. Compare browser Pixel and server-side Conversions API event counts, and inspect available deduplication, match-key coverage and upload-delay diagnostics. Checks are read-only: they do not install pixels, send events or change tracking settings. Dataset access permissions can limit available counts and diagnostics.

What can I do with LinkedIn Ads?
Review campaign and creative performance, leads, wasted spend and professional audience demographics. Reporting is read-only; demographic results are approximate and may be delayed.

What can I do with Google Analytics 4 (GA4)?
Analyze traffic, landing pages, key events, revenue, funnel drop-offs and attribution. Compare outcomes with ad-platform reports. Manage key events (conversions), event create/edit rules, enhanced measurement and data redaction; create or update web streams. Preview each change in a dry run and approve it before applying. Rules affect future events, not historical data. These tools cannot install tags or delete properties or streams.

What can I do with Google Tag Manager (GTM)?
Audit Tag Manager containers, tags, triggers, variables, duplicate tags, consent configuration and unpublished changes. GTM configuration checks do not verify live tag firing.

What can I do with Google Search Console (GSC)?
Analyze Search Console queries, pages, clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position. Investigate organic traffic declines, find keyword opportunities, inspect URL indexing status and review sitemaps. When you ask, submit or remove sitemaps and add or remove Search Console properties; removing a property needs your confirmation. Requesting indexing is not possible through Google's API; use URL Inspection in Search Console.

What can I do with Google Merchant Center (GMC)?
Review Merchant Center account health, product approvals, disapprovals and product issues. Analyze product performance, price benchmarks and competitor visibility where available.

Why did my marketing results change?
Compare relevant connected sources over compatible periods to explain likely drivers and prioritize fixes. Platform-attributed conversions and GA4 outcomes are not deduplicated sales.

How do I get started?
Connect the accounts you need. Access is limited to connected resources. LinkedIn Ads is read-only. GA4, GTM, GSC and GMC settings change only on request and approval. Google Ads and Meta Ads budget updates are checked against your cap. GA4 writes need analytics.edit and property edit permission; reconnect older read-only GA4 connections.
